programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Les deux drôles de dames de NICKELODEON, Jennette McCurdy (Sam de iCarly) et Ariana Grande (Cat de Victorious), reviennent dans une toute nouvelle série INEDITE : Sam & Cat ! La série suit les aventures de ces deux filles rigolotes qu'à priori tout oppose mais qui deviennent petit à petit meilleures amies, colocataires et même associées ! Ensemble elles lancent un service de babysitting, le Sam & Cat's Super Rockin' Fun-Time Babysitting Service !

programme.title: Légendes des Tortues Ninja
Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Les Tortues Ninja sont en fuite et... en solo. Leonardo est le leader, mais il est perdu sans personne à diriger ! À présent, Leo doit arrêter Bishop et ses Méchazoïdes tout en sauvant ses frères.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.sub-title: Die Akte Gentry – Tod nach Dienstschluss
programme.desc:
Matlock vertritt den jungen Unternehmer Craig Gentry. Dieser wird verdächtigt, den Kongressabgeordneten McGinnis umgebracht zu haben.

McGinnis plante vor seinem Tod, die Beziehungen einiger Geschäftsleute von Atlanta zur Mafia aufzudecken, was ihm viele Feinde einbrachte, darunter auch Craig Gentry, der einem Mafiaclan entstammt.

Als dann jedoch zwei Zeugen bestätigen, dass Gentry tatsächlich der Mörder ist, scheint die Lage aussichtslos. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc:
Der Fall um den ermordeten Kongressabgeordneten McGinnis und den Tatverdächtigen Craig Gentry geht weiter.

Trotz der Unschuldsvermutung muss Matlock feststellen, dass es für seinen Mandanten alles andere als gut aussieht. Wie kann der Verdacht gegen ihn ausgeräumt werden?

Als sich der Anwalt zum wiederholten Mal die Fernsehbilder des Tatortes anschaut, entdeckt er einen Hinweis, den er bisher übersehen hatte. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc:
Der Chef eines Fernsehsenders, Robert Ullmann, wird während eines Interviews vergiftet und stirbt.

Ullmanns Geschäftspartner Hal Simpson wird daraufhin sehr schnell für den Mord an seinem Freund verantwortlich gemacht. Doch welches Motiv könnte zu dieser schrecklichen Tat geführt haben?

Obwohl alle Indizien gegen Hal Simpson sprechen, glaubt Matlock an dessen Unschuld und übernimmt die Verteidigung. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc:
Die Autorin einer Ratgeberkolumne, Majorie Manners, soll im Kreise ihrer Familie ein idyllisches Interview geben, als plötzlich ein Mann die Szenerie stört: Craig Moore beschuldigt Manners, Schuld daran zu sein, dass seine Frau ihn verlassen hat.

Als die Journalistin kurz darauf ermordet wird, ist natürlich schnell klar, wer der Hauptverdächtige ist.

Aber ist Craig Moore wirklich so verbittert, dass er jemanden umbringen würde? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc:
Ein neuer Fall wird zur Familienangelegenheit im Hause Matlock: Irwin, der Neffe des Strafverteidigers, steht unter Mordverdacht. Er soll seinen Chef umgebracht haben, der im Kollegenkreis keinen guten Ruf genossen hatte.

Irwin beteuert seine Unschuld, doch das computerüberwachte Steuerungssystem der Gebäudetüren sagt etwas anderes. Matlock unternimmt alles, um seinem Neffen zu helfen.

Wie kann er die technischen Beweise entkräften? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Alle unter einem Dach
programme.desc:
Als Carls Kollegen bei der Polizei dahinterkommen, dass er unter Höhenangst leidet, droht er, seinen Job zu verlieren.

Da es Jahre dauern kann, bis das Problem mit Hilfe eines Psychiaters beseitigt ist, bietet Steve Urkel eine Soforttherapie an.

Carl willigt ein und wird von Steve zu einem Flug in einem Heißluftballon überredet. Die beiden fliegen los, und dann passiert es: Steve stürzt fast aus dem Korb, und nun muss Carl seine Angst überwinden. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Alle unter einem Dach
programme.desc:
Lauras Freundin veranstaltet eine Party. Weil in ihrem Zimmer erst kürzlich ein neuer Teppichboden verlegt wurde, wird die Party auf dem Dach gefeiert.

Trotz der Location kommt die Fete nicht so recht in Schwung. Bis Steve Urkel auftaucht: Als er seinen eigenen Tanz kreiert, kommt Leben in die Bude.

Doch Willie, einer der Jungs, ist eifersüchtig. Er gießt Steve eine ordentliche Portion Schnaps ins Glas – und das ist nicht ganz ungefährlich. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ein Käfig voller Helden
programme.desc:
Kinch braucht Ersatzteile für das Radio der Kriegsgefangenen. Also täuscht Newkirk Zahnschmerzen vor, um einen Arztbesuch zu erschleichen.

In der Stadt kann er seinen Begleiter, Feldwebel Schultz, überreden, im Hofbräuhaus Einkehr zu halten. Während Newkirks Kontaktmann die Teile besorgt, kippen er und Feldwebel Schultz sich einen hinter die Binde.

Schließlich bringt Newkirk seinen betrunkenen Bewacher ins Lager zurück – in einer Schubkarre. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ein Käfig voller Helden
programme.desc:
Den Deutschen ist es gelungen, den französischen Wissenschaftler DuBois gefangen zu nehmen. Sie halten seine Tochter als Geisel fest und zwingen ihn, für die Deutschen zu arbeiten.

Nun müssen die „Helden“ eingreifen: Während Hogan und Newkirk die Geisel befreien, übernimmt LeBeau die Rolle des Wissenschaftlers.

Vater und Tochter flüchten nach London. Im Lager wird derweil das Labor in die Luft gesprengt – und anschließend DuBois für tot erklärt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Jack, ein alter Freund von Colonel Potter, wird bei einer Routineuntersuchung positiv auf Diabetes getestet. Er wird daraufhin für fluguntauglich erklärt, doch für den ehrgeizigen Piloten ist das alles nur bürokratischer Unsinn. Jack ignoriert die Diagnose und setzt sich trotzdem wieder ins Cockpit... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Unverhofft taucht Carlyle Walton, Hawkeyes große Liebe aus der Heimat, im Lazarett auf. Tief getroffen erfährt er, dass seine Jugendliebe mittlerweile verheiratet ist. Doch die Anziehungskraft zwischen die beiden ist noch immer ungebrochen, und bald beginnen sie wieder ein Verhältnis. Carlyle sieht nur einen Ausweg und bittet Colonel Potter um eine Versetzung ... (Senderinfo).

actor.role: Captain Father John Francis Patrick Mulcahy

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Die M*A*S*H-Einheit hat alle Hände voll zu tun, denn das Lazarett erreichen ununterbrochen neue Verwundetentransporte. Langsam geht auch das Blutplasma aus und sogar elementare Dinge wie Gummihandschuhe fehlen den Chirurgen. Zu allem Überfluss soll aus Sicherheitsgründen auch noch das gesamte weibliche Personal abgezogen werden. Aber nicht mit Hot Lips... (Senderinfo).

actor.role: Captain Father John Francis Patrick Mulcahy

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Ein Reporter aus der Heimat will hinter die Kulissen des Lazaretts gucken und bittet alle Mitarbeiter zum Interview. Für viele ist dies eine Gelegenheit, sich mal allen Frust und ihre Sorgen von der Seele zu reden. Andere machen sich einen Spaß daraus. Doch in einem sind sich alle einig: Der Korea-Krieg birgt nichts Gutes... (Senderinfo).

actor.role: Captain Father John Francis Patrick Mulcahy

programme.title: Ein Käfig voller Helden
programme.desc:
Eine deutsche Panzerdivision wird in die Nähe des Lagers verlegt. Natürlich möchte Hogan Einzelheiten über ihre Stärke und ihren Auftrag wissen.

In der Uniform eines deutschen Majors gelingt es ihm, in einer Gastwirtschaft zwei Angehörige der Panzerdivision auszuhorchen. Man verabredet sich für den folgenden Abend, um die Unterhaltung fortzusetzen.

Doch dann taucht Schultz dort auf, um zu Abend zu essen. Die Situation wird gefährlich. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ein Käfig voller Helden
programme.desc:
Die Deutschen scheinen mit dem Stalag 13 etwas Besonderes vorzuhaben: Das Kriegsgefangenenlager soll als Tarnung für Anlagen dienen, die zur Herstellung von synthetischem Benzin gebraucht werden.

Hogan und seinen Männern ist natürlich sofort klar, dass dieser Plan unter allen Umständen verhindert werden muss. Nun ist Fantasie gefragt.

Mit Hilfe eines raffinierten Tricks können Hogan und seine „Helden“ das Vorhaben schließlich unterwandern. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Alle unter einem Dach
programme.desc:
Nach der Trauerfeier von Tante Clotilda kommen Harriette und Rachel mit der Urne nach Hause.

Carl hält die Urne für eine Dose voller Süßigkeiten und versucht in einem unbeobachteten Augenblick, sie zu öffnen. Als Carl von seiner Tochter überrascht wird, lässt er erschrocken die Urne fallen.

Das gute Ding landet ausgerechnet im Müllbeutel mit der Asche vom Kaminfeuer. Carl versucht verzweifelt, die Asche von Tante Clotilda zu identifizieren. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Alle unter einem Dach
programme.desc:
Als Laura in ihrer Schule unversehens mit Rassenhass konfrontiert wird, startet sie eine Unterschriftenaktion. Dadurch will sie erreichen, dass das Fach „Die Geschichte der Schwarzen“ in den Lehrplan aufgenommen wird.

Die Reaktionen, die ihre Aktion hervorruft, lassen sie wünschen, dieses heiße Eisen nie angefasst zu haben.

Weil Carl und Harriette ihrer Tochter helfen möchten, startet der Winslow-Clan einen raffinierten Gegenangriff. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Der WiXXer
programme.desc: Doch als er den Mönch mit der Peitsche überfährt, gibt es Zeugen: das Ehepaar Dubinsky, Touristen aus Bitterfeld. Die Spur führt die Scotland-Yard-Ermittler Very Long und Even Longer zu Lord Cockwoods Blackwhite Castle, einem der letzten Schwarz-Weiß-Schlösser Englands… \n\nDie Komiker und Autoren Oliver Kalkofe („SchleFaZ“), Bastian Pastewka („Perfekt verpasst“) und Oliver Welke („heute-show“, spielt hier Dr. Brinkman) kennen die 60er-Jahre-Edgar-Wallace-Krimis in- und auswendig und drehen sie liebevoll durch den Wolf. In der derb-cleveren Parodie, die auch gestalterisch erstaunlich gelungen ist, glänzt speziell Christoph Maria Herbst („Stromberg“) als Fascho-Butler Alfons Hatler.

programme.title: SchleFaZ – Die schlechtesten Filme aller Zeiten
programme.desc: Mitten im Londoner Hydepark bricht eine Touristin aus Köln plötzlich tot zusammen. Eine Obduktion ergibt, daß die Frau an einem Schock gestorben ist. Klar: Dies ist ein Fall für den englischen Geisterjäger John Sinclair (Florian Fitz) zumal im Rheinland zwei weitere Frauen auf ganz ähnliche Weise das Zeitliche gesegnet habenäWährend die Leichen der Damen makabres Eigenleben entwickeln, macht Sinclair am Kölner Völkerkunde-Institut eine Entdeckung: Bibliothekar Gonsoir (Thierry van Werveke, “Knockin’ on Heaven’s Door“-Killer Nr. 2) übt sich im Voodoo-Zauberä Daß Klaus Knoesel (“High Crusade Frikassee im Weltraum“) ein Schützling von Roland Emmerich (“Independence Day“) ist, beweisen vor allem die spektakulären Effekte, denen auch der Kölner Dom überaus eindrucksvoll zum Opfer fällt.

programme.title: Wild van wild
programme.desc: Het verschil tussen een hert en een ree mag dan wel niet duidelijk zijn voor de man in de straat, voor wildexpert Gert Michiels is het klaar als een klontje: het hert is aanzienlijk groter dan een ree en heeft een véél groter gewei. En, het hert komt in Vlaanderen niet voor, terwijl het ree wel te vinden is hier bij ons. Daarom gaan chef Jan Buytaert en zijn kompaan Gert vandaag op pad in de Ardennen, waar ze sporen zoeken van herten. Die vinden ze erg gemakkelijk en zo leert onze chef weer een heleboel bij over het biotoop en de levenswijze van het hert. Na hun wandeling door de bossen, is het tijd voor het echte werk en bereidt Jan een prachtig hertengebraad met een echte wildsaus.

programme.title: Ben Collins Stunt Driver
programme.desc: Deze documentaire volgt de professionele en toonaangevende stuntrijder Ben Collins, voorheen beter bekend als The Stig in 'Top Gear'. Hij probeert nu om de beste stuntauto voor een achtervolging te vinden.

programme.title: Police Story - Back for Law
programme.desc: De relatie tussen Interpol agent Zhong Wen (Jackie Chan) en zijn dochter Miao Miao is al jaren moeizaam. Daarom is hij aangenaam verrast wanneer zij hem uitnodigt voor een samenkomen in de bar van Wu Jiang.

programme.title: Hellboy: Blood & Iron
programme.desc: Wanneer Hellboy, Liz Sherman en Abe Sapien de opdracht krijgen om het door spoken geteisterde landhuis van een miljardair in de publiciteit te onderzoeken, ontdekken ze een complot om een ​​mooie maar monsterlijke vampier uit het verleden van professor Bruttenholm weer tot leven te wekken.

programme.title: I am Wrath
programme.desc: Stanley is machteloos als zijn vrouw Vivian bruut door tuig wordt vermoord in een parkeergarage. Haar dood is al niet te verkroppen, maar hij slaat pas echt door als de corrupte politie de daders laat lopen.

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: Children of the Sun - Wild Bees
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Live promo: Small products, big industry: Meet the Canton Fair's manufacturing 'hidden champions
programme.desc: At the 140th Canton Fair on Saturday, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, a German tool importer and longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors ranging from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. These specialized SMEs may not be household names, but their smart manufacturing capabilities, comprehensive industrial support and resilient supply chains are a vital source of strength for China's manufacturing sector - and help keep global production moving. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry.

programme.title: Live: Canton Fair's 'hidden champions' - small firms, global reach
programme.desc: They're not household names, but global supply chains depend on them. At the 140th Canton Fair, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, managing director of the Rothenberger Group and a longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors - from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: Inside China's Q3 Economy
programme.desc: China's economy expanded 4.6% in the first three quarters, with exports and high-tech manufacturing continuing to provide support, while consumption and industrial output picked up in September. What do the latest numbers reveal about China's growth momentum and economic transformation? Can renewed momentum and an improved structure help sustain growth in the months ahead? Join BizTalk as leading economists and experts take a closer look at China's Q3 economic performance, unpack the key signals behind the headline numbers, and assess the outlook for growth.

programme.title: Adidas CEO: Competition with Chinese brands makes us better
programme.desc: German sportswear giant Adidas has been in China for decades, but it's no longer just selling a European playbook. Its "In China, For China" model puts designers, creatives and supply chains directly into the bustle of the world's second largest economy - where competition is fierce and Chinese sportswear brands are stronger than ever. Recently in Shanghai, CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu caught up with Adidas global CEO Bjørn Gulden to find out more.

programme.title: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing
programme.desc: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing delves into the historical origins and cultural background of Fengdu Ghost City, and also features the Zhongyuan Festival celebrations and ancestor - worshipping rituals held here. These activities reflect the local people's positive and optimistic outlook on life and death, as well as the great importance they attach to their ancestors, families and family traditions.

programme.title: Outkirts of Wenzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He explores Wenzhou's counties. From geological wonders and daring cliffside stunts at the Yandang Mountains, to rafting along the scenic Nanxi River, to harvesting seaweed and shellfish on the mud flats of the Dongtou Islands, Tianran discovers the ingenious ways the people of Wenzhou have transformed the challenges of living between mountains and seas into their greatest strengths.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.1
programme.desc: Unfolding between the Kunlun, Altai and Tianshan ranges, cradling two vast basins, lies a beautiful land: Xinjiang. Join us on an aerial journey as we ascend the Tianshan to reveal the life-giving secrets of its crystal clear waters, before touching the summit of Bogda Peak, towering 5 km above sea-level, and gliding over the glittering, gem-like Tianchi Lake and the boundless grasslands that extend far beyond what even a bird's eye can see into the west..

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named "Duck Poo Fragrance" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional "yum cha" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling "kueh" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people's southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 1
programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN's Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, "Fun Guide to China". Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port. From the world's largest stand-alone duty-free mall - a true shopper's paradise, to the laid-back charm of an "Old Dad Tea" restaurant, host Tianran He explores the evolving cityscape of Haikou. On the northeast coast in Wenchang, he joins a local photographer to witness the launch of a Chinese space rocket, before diving into interactive space museums that bring the cosmos within reach...

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: Weg Van Jou
programme.desc: Romcom die draait om de stadse Evi (Herbers). Met frisse tegenzin wordt ze door haar werkgever van hip Rotterdam overgeplaatst naar stil Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. Dat het niet allemaal onverstaanbare Zeeuwen zijn, blijkt als Evi in Terneuzen de stoere visser Stijn (Heijmans) ontmoet.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Twee supercompetitieve winkelmedewerkers strijden om de titel 'Medewerker van de Maand' en om het hart van de knappe nieuwe caissière in deze waanzinnige komedie.

programme.title: Bennett's Song
programme.desc: Wanneer twee zeer unieke en diverse families met elk 7 kinderen botsen, vinden ze lachen, muziek, liefde en een paar antwoorden over wat het betekent om een 'normaal' Amerikaans gezin te zijn in de 21e eeuw.

programme.title: Dinner with Friends
programme.desc: Abby kijkt uit naar een ontspannen Thanksgiving met haar beste vriendin Molly. Maar hun plan voor een rustig diner gaat in rook op als Molly’s nieuwe vriendje en haar flamboyante moeder ook ineens aanschuiven.

programme.title: Waar Is Het Geld
programme.desc: In deze heerlijk frisse komedie ontdekt Del, een slimme jongeman uit South Central Los Angeles, dat zijn vader die nog in de gevangenis zit en zijn oom die er net uit is een miljoen hebben gestolen en dat in de kelder van een oud huis hebben verborgen.

programme.title: Crashing Thru
programme.desc: Down the danger trail sweeps a crimson fury... as Renfrew rides again! In this action-packed adventure, Sgt. Renfrew must face off against a group of criminals involved in a gold robbery. With his partner, Constable Kelly, wounded in a gunfight, Renfrew must stop the thieves on his own. Directed by Elmer Clifton; starring James Newill and Warren Hull, this is one adventure you won't want to miss.

programme.title: Sunset Carson Rides Again
programme.desc: Sunset Carson is trying to raise money for a new school and his partner Sam Webster is out to stop him. When Carson plans a benefit prize-fight, Webster plans to make off with the proceeds. Direted by Oliver Drake; starring Sunset Carson, Al Terry, Pat Starling, Ron Ormond, Joe Hiser.

programme.title: Texas Brooklyn and Heaven
programme.desc: When Eddie Tayloe (Guy Madison, 5 Against the House) receives $6,000 from his grandfather, he decides to leave his drab newspaper job and move to New York. His dream is to have a play produced on Broadway. Along the way he picks up a pretty hitchhiker (Diana Lynn, The Miracle of Morgan's Creek) who is also leaving her own dreary life for a shot at New York. Unfortunately, they find that the Big Apple is a hard place to make a living. But it's also a city where circumstances keep bringing them together.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne plays a man wrongly convicted of murder in this exciting western drama from Lone Star Pictures. You'll enjoy plenty of gun action and thundering hoofbeats as he escapes from jail and then joins a gang, hoping to find the real killer! Director Armand Schaefer (The Miracle Rider, The Lost Jungle) whips up some fine performances from a cast of B-movie favorites, including Lane Chandler (Samson and Delilah) and the great stunt rider, Yakima Canutt. And of course, the film features plenty of fight scenes, made memorable by John Wayne's big swinging' right fist! For film buffs: This was one of 11 films Wayne starred in that year, making 1933 one of the busiest years of Wayne's legendary career.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: Slovenia, a small nation of just two million people, is one of Europe’s most surprising delights. Nestled at the crossroads of the Germanic, Mediterranean, and Slavic worlds, it offers a charm all its own.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Granada
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Granada, in Spain’s Andalucía region, discovering its rich history, vibrant culture, and world-famous charm. She visits the stunning Alhambra, enjoys a delicious tapas tour, and experiences the passion of flamenco. Granada’s blend of Moorish heritage and modern energy makes it one of Spain’s most captivating cities. Special thanks to Gayle for an incredible tapas tour.

programme.title: Whats On - 9 - Trade, Exhibitions and Unique Experiences
programme.desc: There is a unique energy that takes over the Mediterranean as the summer heat begins to build. This week, we are bypassing the usual tourist routes to find the heartbeat of the region through its most spectacular festivals. Imagine the sun setting over a lake in Tuscany as the Puccini Festival opens its 72nd season with the powerful melodies of Turandot. From that timeless elegance, we head straight into the high energy of Malta, where the Isle of MTV and the 10th anniversary of the Glitch Festival are turning the islands into a global hub for electronic music. We also explore the stunning heights of the Spanish Pyrenees for the floating stage at Pirineos Sur and hit the iconic cliffs of Santorini for the urban vibes of the Supa Dupa Fly Festival. This is a journey through a region that knows exactly how to celebrate its past while dancing firmly into the future.

programme.title: Help Save the Med HSTM
programme.desc: Help Save the Med highlights actions to protect the Mediterranean Sea, conserve marine biodiversity and promote environmentally friendly methods, raising awareness of the environmental issues facing the region.

programme.title: Made in Med: Heritage of Weaving
programme.sub-title: S01:E01 Made in Med: Heritage of Weaving
programme.desc: Threads, colour and creativity come together in the hands of Alda Bugeja, a textile weaver with more than 50 years of experience. Known for constantly creating new and unique designs, Alda gives Fadi a glimpse into her world, sharing some of the techniques and knowledge she has developed throughout her remarkable career. From the rhythm of the hand loom to the finishing details, discover the patience, imagination, and skill behind her craft.

programme.title: Mediterranean Yoga Move and feel Awake
programme.desc: Mediterranean Yoga is a series that blends Embodiment Yoga with the peaceful beauty of the Mediterranean. Set in stunning coastal and natural locations, each episode encourages viewers to reconnect mind and body through gentle movement, breathwork, and mindfulness in a safe and calming space.

programme.title: Med Nations 02 Greece
programme.desc: Greece has a culture that has been shaped by hundreds of years of ideas, traditions, and life on the sea. From the ancient wonders of Athens to the sun-drenched islands of the Aegean, Greece shows this. This trip shows how Greece still inspires the Mediterranean and the world through its food, music, and long history.

programme.title: Med Minds 07 Dali
programme.desc: Salvador Dalí, the eccentric Mediterranean visionary, turned his life into art and became one of history’s most unforgettable minds.

programme.title: Verona I della Scala
programme.desc: This episode tells Verona’s story through the rise and fall of the Della Scala family, pioneers of the Italian Renaissance. From Cangrande to Mastino II, we follow their power struggle with Venice, booming trade, and eventual exile to Bavaria.

programme.title: Isabella Turso Sliding Doors
programme.desc: An Original Music Video by Isabella Turso.

programme.title: Whats On - 8 - Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.title: Fadi Abou Rjeili Sirena
programme.desc: A heartfelt musical tribute to Malta, celebrating the island’s distinctive character, cultural heritage and enduring connection with its people. Set against the backdrop of the Mediterranean, this music video captures the beauty, spirit and identity of the Maltese Island.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: Here along the Côte d’Azur, we wander the sunlit promenades of Nice, catch whispers of fortunes changing hands at Monaco’s famed casino, and step inside the elegant villas once home to artists and heiresses.

programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Menorca, from Mahon’s markets and history to Ciutadella’s gothic charm and northern beaches. In Es Migjorn Gran, she hikes to ancient caves, visits Binigaus beach, and also learns to make Mahon style cheese.

programme.desc: OUTDOOR & Nature, a weekly program that highlights sports, outdoor activities, and the breathtaking scenery of Cyprus, will introduce you to the great outdoors. Each episode highlights government initiatives, community organisations, and volunteer efforts to preserve Cyprus's natural heritage while examining nature, wildlife, and conservation. After moving to the Netherlands as a child, she is returning to the Mediterranean to rediscover her roots. Starting with the raw beauty of her home island, she invites you to explore the Mediterranean through a lens of discovery and belonging.

programme.desc: We'll explore flamboyant Sevilla, where orange trees ring lacy palaces, bullfighting is still a cultural event, and little girls dream of growing up to become flamenco dancers.

programme.title: Whats On - 9 - Trade, Exhibitions and Unique Experiences
programme.desc: There is a unique energy that takes over the Mediterranean as the summer heat begins to build. This week, we are bypassing the usual tourist routes to find the heartbeat of the region through its most spectacular festivals. Imagine the sun setting over a lake in Tuscany as the Puccini Festival opens its 72nd season with the powerful melodies of Turandot. From that timeless elegance, we head straight into the high energy of Malta, where the Isle of MTV and the 10th anniversary of the Glitch Festival are turning the islands into a global hub for electronic music. We also explore the stunning heights of the Spanish Pyrenees for the floating stage at Pirineos Sur and hit the iconic cliffs of Santorini for the urban vibes of the Supa Dupa Fly Festival. This is a journey through a region that knows exactly how to celebrate its past while dancing firmly into the future.

programme.title: Med Minds 07 Dali
programme.desc: Salvador Dalí, the eccentric Mediterranean visionary, turned his life into art and became one of history’s most unforgettable minds.

programme.title: Med Nations 02 Greece
programme.desc: Greece has a culture that has been shaped by hundreds of years of ideas, traditions, and life on the sea. From the ancient wonders of Athens to the sun-drenched islands of the Aegean, Greece shows this. This trip shows how Greece still inspires the Mediterranean and the world through its food, music, and long history.

programme.title: The tapestries of the Grand Master Restoration
programme.desc: Towards the end of summer 1710, a precious cargo was unloaded on the shores of the Grand Harbour. Whoever opened that merchandise and laid eyes on it for the first time must surely have been astonished by its beauty. The tapestries of the Grand Master’s Palace had arrived in Malta. Watch their 300-year-old story unfold in this documentary by Heritage Malta.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Calabria
programme.desc: Malini explores Calabria, a hidden gem in Southern Italy. While its coastal towns like Tropea and Scilla boast turquoise seas, Calabria’s true charm lies in its rural interior, where traditions like handmade pasta, cheese, and salami are still alive. She visits ghost villages like Pentedattilo in the Aspromonte mountains and experiences authentic Calabrian culture, food, and hospitality, hosted by Calabria Etnica.

programme.title: Womanity
programme.desc: The story of the "positive force" that women exert in society: in the family environment as in communities, in the workplace as well as in politics, a force and an action able to always act, despite the numerous difficulties.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.desc: Joy, a working mother, assumes a girls' weekend at a haunted plantation will be a pleasant change of pace.

programme.desc: Angelina Balistreri believes her home is haunted by a harmless ghost, while her husband, Emiliano, is skeptical of the paranormal. They call in a priest and medium who makes contact with a troubled ghost and helps him cross over and find peace.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After her mother Linda returns from a trip, Kara Dravis begins experiencing unexplained and terrifying events.

programme.desc: When Phil Pritchard's beloved father dies, he falls into a deep depression that renders him vulnerable to an unearthly, evil entity that begins influencing him.

programme.desc: When Tracey Berrios experiences paranormal activities inside her new home, she suspects the spirits tied to the house's history. When something evil attacks Tracey, she turns to paranormal investigators for help.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Tammy Shea, a single mother of three, relocates her family for a fresh start, but her dream turns to a nightmare when her family is antagonized by multiple entities. Desperate, Tammy finds a paranormal team who reveals the true evil in the home.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: As Deborah Utley begins experiencing paranormal events in her home, she turns to her faith for protection.

programme.desc: Løytnant Johnny Firpo har som hemmelig oppdrag å bekjempe et gambling-syndikat på USA's østkyst. Hans halvbror Charlie er en forhenværende gambler som kjenner alle knepe. Han går motvillig med på å hjelpe Johnny, og sammen renser de opp i Miamis underverden.

programme.desc: Vi befinner oss tidlig på 1600-tallet i føydaltidens Japan, og en mann til hest kjemper mot en gruppe samuraier for så å bli tatt til fange.

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Flis; rotten sensei; føler at hans fire ungdoms skilpaddedisipler har vokst fra hverandre og trenger å knytte bånd for å beseire et eldgammelt monster.

programme.title: Skurker og banditter
programme.desc: Tony Roma er tidenes sleipeste gigolo, en skøyer som tar det meste på sparket, spesialisert på å rappe rike husmødres diamanter. Til slutt kobles den hemmelige politimannen Parker inn for endelig å få fakket gigoloen.

programme.title: Supersnooper
programme.desc: Terence Hill er den nyutdannede politimannen Dave Speed, som skal innkassere en parkeringsbot langt ute i ødemarken. Desverre er dette også steder hvor forsvaret foretar topphemmelige prøvesprengninger med atomvåpen.

programme.title: Pompeii
programme.desc: Gled deg til den episke historien om slaven Milo, som er gladiator i det romerske keiserriket. Mens vulkanen Vesuv spyr ut sin ødeleggende lava, må Milo i et kappløp med tiden redde sin store kjærlighet, Cassia.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Cam er sykkelbud i New Yorks livsfarlige gater. Han kan klare alt på to hjul, men en gjeld til en lokal mafiabande tvinger ham til å ta beina på nakken. Helt til han ved en tilfeldighet møter den vakre og forførende Nikki.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: Children of the Sun - Wild Bees
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: Live: Canton Fair's 'hidden champions' - small firms, global reach
programme.desc: They're not household names, but global supply chains depend on them. At the 140th Canton Fair, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, managing director of the Rothenberger Group and a longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors - from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. These specialized SMEs are the backbone of China's manufacturing sector - and help keep global production moving. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: Inside China's Q3 Economy
programme.desc: China's economy expanded 4.6% in the first three quarters, with exports and high-tech manufacturing continuing to provide support, while consumption and industrial output picked up in September. programme.title: Adidas CEO: Competition with Chinese brands makes us better
programme.desc: German sportswear giant Adidas has been in China for decades, but it's no longer just selling a European playbook. programme.desc: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing delves into the historical origins and cultural background of Fengdu Ghost City, and also features the Zhongyuan Festival celebrations and ancestor - worshipping rituals held here. programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.1
programme.desc: Unfolding between the Kunlun, Altai and Tianshan ranges, cradling two vast basins, lies a beautiful land: Xinjiang. Join us on an aerial journey as we ascend the Tianshan to reveal the life-giving secrets of its crystal clear waters, before touching the summit of Bogda Peak, towering 5 km above sea-level, and gliding over the glittering, gem-like Tianchi Lake and the boundless grasslands that extend far beyond what even a bird's eye can see into the west..

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named "Duck Poo Fragrance" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional "yum cha" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling "kueh" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. programme.title: Sunset Carson Rides Again
programme.desc: Sunset Carson is trying to raise money for a new school and his partner Sam Webster is out to stop him. When Carson plans a benefit prize-fight, Webster plans to make off with the proceeds. Direted by Oliver Drake; starring Sunset Carson, Al Terry, Pat Starling, Ron Ormond, Joe Hiser.

programme.title: Texas Brooklyn and Heaven
programme.desc: When Eddie Tayloe (Guy Madison, 5 Against the House) receives $6,000 from his grandfather, he decides to leave his drab newspaper job and move to New York. His dream is to have a play produced on Broadway. Along the way he picks up a pretty hitchhiker (Diana Lynn, The Miracle of Morgan's Creek) who is also leaving her own dreary life for a shot at New York. Unfortunately, they find that the Big Apple is a hard place to make a living. But it's also a city where circumstances keep bringing them together.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne plays a man wrongly convicted of murder in this exciting western drama from Lone Star Pictures. You'll enjoy plenty of gun action and thundering hoofbeats as he escapes from jail and then joins a gang, hoping to find the real killer! Director Armand Schaefer (The Miracle Rider, The Lost Jungle) whips up some fine performances from a cast of B-movie favorites, including Lane Chandler (Samson and Delilah) and the great stunt rider, Yakima Canutt. And of course, the film features plenty of fight scenes, made memorable by John Wayne's big swinging' right fist! For film buffs: This was one of 11 films Wayne starred in that year, making 1933 one of the busiest years of Wayne's legendary career.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling.

programme.title: Daughter of the West
programme.desc: A FLAMING PAGE FROM AMERICAN HISTORY Becomes a powerful motion picture...set against the panoramic grandeur of the West!. Martha Vickers stars as Lolita Moreno, a convent raised woman in the 1880s who learns about her Native American heritage through her relationship with an educated Navajo. Morena had been raised at a California mission, but when she leaves to teach school in Arizona, the threads of her mysterious past are revealed. This leads to her involvement with some dangerous people, and a chance to find love in the most unexpected way. The cast includes Phillip Reed, Donald Woods, William Farnum and Milton Kibbee. Pedro de Cordobaa stars as Chief Wykomas.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Granada
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Granada, in Spain’s Andalucía region, discovering its rich history, vibrant culture, and world-famous charm. She visits the stunning Alhambra, enjoys a delicious tapas tour, and experiences the passion of flamenco. Granada’s blend of Moorish heritage and modern energy makes it one of Spain’s most captivating cities. Special thanks to Gayle for an incredible tapas tour.

programme.title: Whats On - 9 - Trade, Exhibitions and Unique Experiences
programme.desc: There is a unique energy that takes over the Mediterranean as the summer heat begins to build. This week, we are bypassing the usual tourist routes to find the heartbeat of the region through its most spectacular festivals. Imagine the sun setting over a lake in Tuscany as the Puccini Festival opens its 72nd season with the powerful melodies of Turandot. From that timeless elegance, we head straight into the high energy of Malta, where the Isle of MTV and the 10th anniversary of the Glitch Festival are turning the islands into a global hub for electronic music. We also explore the stunning heights of the Spanish Pyrenees for the floating stage at Pirineos Sur and hit the iconic cliffs of Santorini for the urban vibes of the Supa Dupa Fly Festival. This is a journey through a region that knows exactly how to celebrate its past while dancing firmly into the future.

programme.title: Help Save the Med HSTM
programme.desc: Help Save the Med highlights actions to protect the Mediterranean Sea, conserve marine biodiversity and promote environmentally friendly methods, raising awareness of the environmental issues facing the region.

programme.title: Made in Med: Heritage of Weaving
programme.sub-title: S01:E01 Made in Med: Heritage of Weaving
programme.desc: Threads, colour and creativity come together in the hands of Alda Bugeja, a textile weaver with more than 50 years of experience. Known for constantly creating new and unique designs, Alda gives Fadi a glimpse into her world, sharing some of the techniques and knowledge she has developed throughout her remarkable career. From the rhythm of the hand loom to the finishing details, discover the patience, imagination, and skill behind her craft.

programme.title: Mediterranean Yoga Move and feel Awake
programme.desc: Mediterranean Yoga is a series that blends Embodiment Yoga with the peaceful beauty of the Mediterranean. Set in stunning coastal and natural locations, each episode encourages viewers to reconnect mind and body through gentle movement, breathwork, and mindfulness in a safe and calming space.

programme.title: Med Nations 02 Greece
programme.desc: Greece has a culture that has been shaped by hundreds of years of ideas, traditions, and life on the sea. From the ancient wonders of Athens to the sun-drenched islands of the Aegean, Greece shows this. This trip shows how Greece still inspires the Mediterranean and the world through its food, music, and long history.

programme.title: Med Minds 07 Dali
programme.desc: Salvador Dalí, the eccentric Mediterranean visionary, turned his life into art and became one of history’s most unforgettable minds.

programme.title: Verona I della Scala
programme.desc: This episode tells Verona’s story through the rise and fall of the Della Scala family, pioneers of the Italian Renaissance. From Cangrande to Mastino II, we follow their power struggle with Venice, booming trade, and eventual exile to Bavaria.

programme.title: Isabella Turso Sliding Doors
programme.desc: An Original Music Video by Isabella Turso.

programme.title: Whats On - 8 - Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.title: Fadi Abou Rjeili Sirena

programme.title: Too Many Tonys
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Hinter Gittern – Der Frauenknast
programme.desc:
Jutta verbietet Denise das Training außerhalb von Reutlitz. Daraufhin erpresst Denise Jutta mit deren heimlichen Verhältnis zu Jörg.

Die Vattkes werden wieder aus dem Bunker entlassen. Sie sind davon überzeugt, dass Walter ihre Fluchtpläne verraten hat. Sie schlagen Walter zusammen und bringen sie in ein abgelegenes Verlies.

Ilse verleugnet derweil auf Rat ihres Verlegers ihre Beziehung zu Gregor, um sich als alleinstehende Autorin zu vermarkten. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hinter Gittern – Der Frauenknast
programme.desc: Nur kurz nachdem Jörg Jutta einen Heiratsantrag gemacht hat, erwischt sie ihn mit Simone im Bett. Tief verletzt sinnt Jutta auf Rache. Doch es kommt tatsächlich noch einmal zu einer romantischen Wendung.\n\nIndes wird Anna immer dann, wenn sie an ihre gescheiterten Beziehungen zu Männern denkt, von heftigen Kopfschmerzattacken geplagt. Das hält sie jedoch nicht davon ab, per Kontaktanzeige die Bekanntschaft eines neuen Mannes zu suchen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hinter Gittern – Der Frauenknast
programme.desc:
Die Nonne Ruth wird wegen des tätlichen Angriffs auf einen Polizisten inhaftiert. Weil sie ihre Nonnentracht nicht ablegen will, kommt sie in den Bunker und tritt in den Hungerstreik.

Simone wird von einem Freier bedrängt. Als der ihre trügerische Familienidylle in Gefahr bringt, kommt es zur Katastrophe.

Uschi hegt den Verdacht, Anna könne etwas mit dem Mord auf der Kirmes zu tun haben. Um nicht enttarnt zu werden, verleumdet Anna Uschi. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Noord-Zuid-Oost-West
programme.desc: Historicus Maarten van Rossem vertelt over opmerkelijke gebeurtenissen uit andere tijden. Al drie generaties maakt de Italiaanse familie De Lorenzo ijs in Utrecht. Deze keer duikt Maarten in de bijzondere geschiedenis van deze immigrantenfamilie. In Natuurlijk Zoëy is presentator Eddy Zoëy op meubelboulevard Kanaleneiland in Utrecht, ook wel de meeuwenboulevard genoemd. Meeuwen trekken steeds meer naar de stad, hoe komt dat?

programme.title: Andere Tijden Kort
programme.desc: Pim Fortuyn of Willem van Oranje? Wie is de grootste Nederlander? Om dit te bepalen wordt in 2004 een verkiezing georganiseerd waar het publiek een rol in speelt. De inwoners van Nederland mogen stemmen op de persoon die zij de titel: 'Grootste Nederlander aller tijden', willen geven. Maar belangrijke beslissingen aan een publiek overlaten in politiek spannende tijden, is dat geen recept voor problemen?
